abi_target: 64bit little-endian; uint16/32/64 fixed widths; align natural max8; no packing pragmas, no C enum/bool/long/size_t field
layout_rule: Natural C member alignment, no packing/explicit over-alignment; array helper lengthU32/reservedU32 plus fixedinline elements has max natural memberalignment (4 for U32/Enum32 elements,8 where memberrequires). Round sizeof to structnaturalalignment. Every number proposed/documentary, future C/C++ x64 offsetof/align/sizeof proof required.
mask_rule: present_mask subset of observed_mask; required nonnullable fields need both bits. Nullable unavailable=observed0/present0, actual null nullable=observed1/present0, observed numeric0=observed1/present1 withvalue0. Failed/pending/N/A afterfacets unobserved+absent. Inactive union bytes zero and absent. Unknown fixed required field terminates capture NO_PAYLOAD, never creates0row.

source_generation_rule: Source callback args ObjectArg generation MUSTunobserved/zero; sink resolves ENTRY identity from own21entry birthledger/actual constructor tokens, and reserves monotonic generations at creatorENTRY. Public APP accepts no raw/generation/type/role inputs. CallIDs/epochs/births/clock are not supplied in eventPODs.
not_claimed: No compiled sizeof/align/offsetof, generated ABI conformance, actual source-fit or whole-process memory bound.
C_vs_wire: C member returned_mark maps unchanged JSON key return. All other explicitly named C structs use their layout member names; stored original payloads and derived SourceAfter/Call fields are separate from callback-input PODs. InputSourceAfter contains direct original source associations only, no IDs/gens/births.
mask_validation: present subset observed; observed/present bits >= mask_field_count MUST0. Named reservedfields, inlinearrayunusedtail and inactiveuniontailstorage MUST0; nonzero namedreserved storage INVALID metadata, never an extension. Implicit C padding is not a field/fact and is ignored, not read as evidence. Zero-init all ownedPODs before typed assignment.
